stories.title: Russian drone hits Kyiv-Warsaw passenger train carrying dignitaries near Polish border
new_facts: Boris Johnson's train was evacuated after a Russian drone strike hit the Kyiv-Warsaw rail line near the Polish border.
Overnight barrage of 450+ drones/missiles killed at least six and injured 40+ across Ukraine; foreign minister calls strike 'Putin's terror knocking on EU/Nato doors'.
Names ex-Swedish PM Carl Bildt among foreign officials whose train had passed on the struck line minutes earlier.
Ukrainian and Polish officials describe the rail strikes as a 'systemic attack' on Ukraine's railway network, broadening the campaign beyond fuel sites.
stories.line: Russian drone struck a passenger train traveling between Kyiv and Warsaw, forcing evacuation of dignitaries including Boris Johnson near the Polish border.
